description:
Create a circular lifecycle diagram in Wondershare EdrawMax showing the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The diagram must have six phases arranged in a circular (ring) layout with directional arrows connecting them in a continuous clockwise cycle.

Phases (clockwise from the top):
1. Requirements
2. Design
3. Implementation
4. Testing
5. Deployment
6. Maintenance

Connect them with arrows forming a complete cycle: Requirements → Design → Implementation → Testing → Deployment → Maintenance → Requirements.

Add a title: "Software Development Life Cycle"

Save the diagram as: ~/Documents/sdlc_lifecycle.eddx
Export as PNG to: ~/Documents/sdlc_lifecycle.png
